title: Injective representative computation of the derived exchange
statement: For f:X→S and a geometric point s, an injective bounded-below representative J with q:K≅Q(J) computes the localized derived mate before applying global sections: after inverse source-direct-image comparison it equals Q of termwise underived exchange followed by the target direct-image unit and transport by exact pullback of q.inv. The target unit is retained.

proof.text: Lift the specified representative isomorphism to the bounded-below derived category. Apply the proved derived-mate factorization with pullbackSquareComparison_hom_app_factorsh, then use naturality in the inverse lift. Precompose its image under the inclusion by the inverse exact source pullback comparison. Expand source transport using the source-transport lemma and rewrite the resulting underived-exchange and target-unit composite by the target-transport lemma. Functoriality and associativity give the stated equality.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03Q9, final injective-complex paragraph; derived mate factorization with two transport identities
